    defstruct [
      :relationship,
      :query,
      :actor,
      :tenant,
      :tracer,
      :authorize?,
      :domain,
      source_context: %{}
    ]

    @type t :: %__MODULE__{
            relationship: Ash.Resource.Relationships.relationship(),
            query: Ash.Query.t(),
            actor: term,
            tracer: atom | list(atom) | nil,
            tenant: term,
            source_context: map(),
            authorize?: boolean,
            domain: module
          }
  end

  @callback select(opts :: Keyword.t()) :: list(atom) | :*

  @callback load(
              list(Ash.Resource.Record.t()),
              opts :: Keyword.t(),
              context :: Context.t()
            ) ::

  use Ash.Resource.ManualCreate
  import Ash.Expr
  require Ash.Query

  def create(changeset, _opts, _context) do
    ThreadGraph.Forum.LoadCounter.bump(:fork)

    sid = changeset.arguments[:source_message_id]
    slug = changeset.arguments[:slug]
    title = changeset.arguments[:title]

    res = Ash.get(ThreadGraph.Forum.Message, sid, domain: ThreadGraph.Forum, load: [:thread])

    case res do
      {:error, _} ->
        {:error,
         Ash.Error.Invalid.exception(errors: [
           Ash.Error.Changes.InvalidArgument.exception(
             field: :source_message_id,
             message: "source message not found"
           )
         ])}

      {:ok, s} ->
        if s.thread.locked do
          {:error,
           Ash.Error.Invalid.exception(errors: [
             Ash.Error.Changes.InvalidArgument.exception(
               field: :source_message_id,
               message: "source thread is locked"
             )
           ])}
        else
          board = s.thread.board
          Process.put(:fork_thread_id, nil)
          Process.put(:fork_msg_ids, [])
          Process.put(:fork_link_ids, [])

          try do
            new_thread =
              ThreadGraph.Forum.Thread
              |> Ash.Changeset.for_create(:create, %{
                slug: slug,
                title: title,
                board: board,
                locked: false
              })
              |> Ash.create!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)

            Process.put(:fork_thread_id, new_thread.id)
            desc = collect_descendants(s.id)
            all = [s | desc]

            sorted = Enum.sort_by(all, &{&1.position, &1.id})
            pos_map = Map.new(Enum.with_index(sorted, 1), fn {m, i} -> {m.id, i} end)
            topo = topological_order(s, all)

            {_, msgs} =
              Enum.reduce(topo, {%{}, []}, fn m, {msg_map, msgs} ->
                pid = if m.id == s.id, do: nil, else: msg_map[m.parent_id]

                nm =
                  ThreadGraph.Forum.Message
                  |> Ash.Changeset.for_create(:create, %{
                    body: m.body,
                    score: m.score,
                    author_id: m.author_id,
                    thread_id: new_thread.id,
                    parent_id: pid,
                    position: pos_map[m.id]
                  })
                  |> Ash.create!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)

                Process.put(:fork_msg_ids, [nm.id | Process.get(:fork_msg_ids)])
                {Map.put(msg_map, m.id, nm.id), [nm | msgs]}
              end)

            msgs = Enum.reverse(msgs)
            copy_of_s = hd(msgs)

            link =
              ThreadGraph.Forum.MessageLink
              |> Ash.Changeset.for_create(:create, %{
                kind: :fork_of,
                from_message_id: copy_of_s.id,
                to_message_id: s.id
              })
              |> Ash.create!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)

            Process.put(:fork_link_ids, [link.id | Process.get(:fork_link_ids)])
            {:ok, new_thread}
          rescue

              rollback()
              reraise e, __STACKTRACE__
          after
            Process.delete(:fork_thread_id)
            Process.delete(:fork_msg_ids)
            Process.delete(:fork_link_ids)
          end
        end

    msgs = Process.get(:fork_msg_ids, [])
    links = Process.get(:fork_link_ids, [])
    thread_id = Process.get(:fork_thread_id)

    for id <- links, do: destroy_safe(ThreadGraph.Forum.MessageLink, id)
    for id <- msgs, do: destroy_safe(ThreadGraph.Forum.Message, id)
    if thread_id, do: destroy_safe(ThreadGraph.Forum.Thread, thread_id)
    :ok
  end

  defp destroy_safe(res, id) do
    if Ash.get!(res, id, domain: ThreadGraph.Forum) do
      Ash.destroy!(Ash.get!(res, id, domain: ThreadGraph.Forum), domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)
    end
  rescue
    _ -> :ok
  end

  defp collect_descendants(sid) do
    children = read_children([sid])
    children ++ Enum.flat_map(children, &collect_descendants(&1.id))
  end

  defp read_children(pids) do
    ThreadGraph.Forum.Message
    |> Ash.Query.new()
    |> Ash.Query.filter(expr(parent_id in ^pids))
    |> Ash.read!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)
  end

  defp topological_order(s, all) do
    build_topo([s], [s.id], all)
  end

  defp build_topo(order, pids, all) do
    children = Enum.filter(all, fn m -> m.parent_id in pids and m.id not in Enum.map(order, & &1.id) end)
    if Enum.empty?(children) do
      order
    else
      build_topo(order ++ children, Enum.map(children, & &1.id), all)
    end
  end

defmodule ThreadGraph.Forum.Messages.CrossBoardHighlights do
  use Ash.Resource.ManualRead
  import Ash.Expr
  require Ash.Query

  def read(query, _data_layer_query, _opts, _context) do
    ThreadGraph.Forum.LoadCounter.bump(:cross_board_highlights)

    _boards = query.arguments[:boards]
    min_end = query.arguments[:min_endorsements] || 0

    base =
      ThreadGraph.Forum.Message
      |> Ash.Query.for_read(:read, %{})
      |> struct(filter: query.filter)

    messages = Ash.read!(base, domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)

    msg_ids = MapSet.new(Enum.map(messages, & &1.id))

    link_counts =
      if Enum.empty?(msg_ids) do
        %{}
      else
        ThreadGraph.Forum.MessageLink
        |> Ash.Query.new()
        |> Ash.Query.filter(expr(to_message_id in ^msg_ids and kind == :follow_up))
        |> Ash.Query.aggregate(:count, :id, :count, group: [:to_message_id])
        |> Ash.read!(domain: ThreadGraph.Forum)
        |> Map.new(fn {mid, count} -> {mid, count} end)
      end

    results =
      Enum.filter(messages, fn m ->
        count = Map.get(link_counts, m.id, 0)
        count >= min_end
      end)
      |> Enum.map(fn m ->
        count = Map.get(link_counts, m.id, 0)
        Ash.Resource.set_metadata(m, %{endorsement_count: count})
      end)

    results =
      if Enum.empty?(query.sort) do
        Enum.sort_by(results, fn m ->
          count = Map.get(link_counts, m.id, 0)
          {-count, m.position, m.id}
        end)
      else
        results
      end

    results =
      if query.offset do
        Enum.drop(results, query.offset)
      else
        results
      end

    results =
      if query.limit do
        Enum.take(results, query.limit)
      else
        results
      end

    {:ok, results}
  end
